token_family_info.$value: Interaction colours that do not carry an emphasis level. Peer of emphasis_high and emphasis_low, resolved straight into the compiled tier with no entry in s2, so the emphasis mode never reaches it. For elements that need hover and active feedback but no emphasis: cards, table rows, menu items, tags. Values start as a copy of emphasis_low and are independent of it from here on. Use: interactive surfaces that must stay neutral whatever the emphasis mode. Avoid: anything that should follow the emphasis mode.

token_family_info.$value: Visited link colour. A resting colour, not a computed state: a visited link is a different colour, not a modifier applied to the unvisited one. Emphasis does not apply, visitedness does not change with it. Peer of the emphasis branches and resolved straight into the compiled tier. Use: the visited condition on links. Avoid: anywhere the colour is derived from a resting colour rather than replacing it.

token_family_info.$value: Navigation color tokens. Used for top navigation bar, left navigation panel, and tab components. Emphasis mode (high/low) has no effect. Backgrounds use the cobalt scale; red is reserved for borders and brand indicators only.

fg.$description: Navigation foreground — text. Always uses the highest contrast cobalt value; navigation text is black regardless of color_scheme mode.

fg_disabled.$description: Navigation foreground — disabled. Muted text/icon color using the universal cobalt disabled scale.

contrast_high.$description: Navigation background — high contrast. Applies where a strong surface fill is required (e.g. pressed, selected).

contrast_medium.$description: Navigation background — medium contrast. Applies in hover and focus states for a visible but non-dominant surface.

contrast_low.$description: Navigation background — low contrast. Applies in enabled state for a subtle surface that does not dominate the layout.

solid.$description: Navigation background — disabled solid. Opaque muted surface for disabled navigation items.

opacity.$description: Navigation background — disabled opacity. Semi-transparent muted surface for disabled navigation items.

brand.$description: Navigation border — brand. Uses ob.p.color.brand.accent (federal red in CH_app). Applied to selected and pressed states as the primary brand indicator line.

subtle.$description: Navigation border — subtle. Lighter red shade for non-active borders (enabled, hover, focus states).

disabled.$description: Navigation border — disabled. Muted border using the cobalt_alpha disabled scale.
